questions.q: Which instrument group forms the basso continuo in Baroque music?
questions.why: The continuo is a bass instrument plus a chord instrument (harpsichord/organ/lute).

questions.q: Which feature is most typical of Classical (c.1750–1820) music?
options: Terraced dynamics and a harpsichord continuo
Balanced four-bar phrases over simple harmony
questions.why: Classical music is clear and balanced: regular phrases, simple primary chords.
Chromatic harmony, rubato and wide dynamics are Romantic; the others are Classical or Baroque.

questions.q: Give three features that would help you decide that an excerpt is Baroque.
questions.model: Harpsichord or organ playing a basso continuo; polyphonic/contrapuntal texture with imitation; terraced dynamics; ornamentation such as trills; a small string orchestra.
